candidate_diagrams.claim: For the three-vertex path skeleton A-B-C with no unshielded collider, the Markov-equivalence class has the three no-collider DAG orientations; its CPDAG retains both edges undirected. The collider orientation A→B←C is excluded from this class.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The definition is specifically about graph skeletons, unshielded colliders, compelled orientations, and the set of consistent DAG extensions. A single compact CPDAG with its exact extensions makes the distinction between an undirected CPDAG edge and its directed extensions concrete.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Show the CPDAG A—B—C, then three aligned extension rows A→B→C, A←B←C, and A←B→C. Label them as the no-unshielded-collider extensions. Optionally show A→B←C separately as excluded because it creates an unshielded collider absent from the CPDAG. Do not imply the listed orientations exhaust all possible DAGs on three vertices, only this equivalence class.
